exercises.prompt: Select the correct nisbah adjective formed from مَكَّةُ ('Meccan'):
exercises.explanation: Forming the nisbah removes tāʾ marbūṭah (ة) and suffixes ـِيٌّ: مَكِّيٌّ.

feedback.rule: Drop ة before adding the nisbah suffix ـِيٌّ.

exercises.prompt: Which pattern represents an intensive adjectival form (ṣīghat mubālaghah)?
exercises.explanation: فَعَّالٌ (like غَفَّارٌ, تَوَّابٌ) is a classic intensive pattern denoting abundant/habitual action.

feedback.rule: Intensive patterns: فَعَّالٌ, فَعُولٌ, فَعِيلٌ, مِفْعَالٌ.
